key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:L/Disk-Validator:0:0000
name: format_counter_text_and_init
description: Writes two text characters showing a counter from a global state field, a space when the counter is below ten and otherwise a digit from an indirect call. It then stores several state words, runs an indirect routine and loops over a table.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:0000
name: clear_long_table_then_setup
description: Zeroes a block of longwords at an offset computed from a global, stores a pointer and a value near its start, then calls a further routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:016E
name: open_system_libraries
description: Opens the libraries named in its text references through indirect calls, stores the returned handles in globals, and returns a failure code when an open fails.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:08BA
name: release_flagged_buffers
description: Checks bits in global flag bytes and, for each set bit, passes a stored pointer and a fixed size constant to an indirect routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:0B36
name: build_six_entry_record_index
description: Calls an indirect routine with fixed constants, then walks a length-prefixed record list from a global pointer and stores six pointer and length pairs in global arrays.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:0BCC
name: try_open_adjacent_door
description: Probes the given grid cell and its neighbours through an indirect test, converts the chosen cell to tile units and calls an indirect routine with it. The strings 'It opened.' and 'It's locked.' show that it handles doors.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:0EEE
name: setup_display_and_game_state
description: Clears a flag, calls a sequence of indirect library routines to set up display and font state, and initialises global pointers and counters. Its text references 'hiscreen' and 'page0' show that it prepares the screen and page bitmaps.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:5778
name: update_position_and_refresh
description: Updates the current and previous x and y globals from the parameters, optionally computes a tile index from the coordinates, then calls further routines and loops on an indirect call until it returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:585C
name: find_range_entry_state
description: Selects one of two range tables by a global counter, scans it for the entry whose byte range contains a global value, and derives a state byte from that entry's type byte, invoking callbacks when the state changes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:5B7E
name: sync_frame_index_from_table
description: Reads a byte from a global structure through an indirect call and adds it to an offset byte. When a stored short differs from the table entry indexed by a global word, it stores the new value and sets flags.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:5C00
name: find_valid_spot_near_origin
description: Tries up to fifteen offsets around a global origin, each checked by an indirect test, and falls back to fixed coordinates when no offset passes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:5DF0
name: reset_slot_state
description: Computes a slot index through an indirect call and, when that slot's countdown is not positive and its kind is not fourteen or fifteen, clears the countdown, sets state bytes and calls an indirect routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:5EBA
name: set_mode_and_reset_flags
description: Stores a mode byte of six when the parameter is ten and five otherwise. When the parameter differs from the current global, it reloads state and invokes three indirect routines, then recomputes two positional globals and clears several flag bytes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:5F98
name: reset_game_state_globals
description: Writes a fixed set of starting constants and cleared flags into globals. A zero parameter triggers one indirect routine, and otherwise further initialisation runs.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:638C
name: compute_display_offsets
description: Derives several screen coordinate globals from its parameter and an indirect result, such as 160 minus the parameter and 95 minus the other value. It then calls indirect routines to set up the display rectangle.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:643C
name: select_animation_frame
description: Chooses an index from several global values and conditionals, then calls an indirect routine with no arguments or with four pointers from a table, depending on a flag and the parameter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:6544
name: update_position_and_state
description: Converts two position words into a small cell index, updates a global state word and calls a routine when that index changes. It then passes two derived words from a global to an indirect call.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:6670
name: swap_buffer_pointers
description: Swaps two stored pointers, copies the first long and a word from the swapped structure into globals, runs three indirect routines on the working buffer and then calls one more routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:66C6
name: open_input_device
description: Clears two flag bytes, creates a message port and I/O request, and opens the input.device named in its strings. It releases the port again when a step fails.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:6776
name: configure_io_request_then_cleanup
description: Sets a request type and a data pointer on an I/O request, runs three indirect routines on it, then calls the cleanup routine on the stored message port.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:67BC
name: collect_flagged_slots_and_fill
description: Collects up to twelve entries from a byte table whose flag bit is set into an index array, then fills the remaining slots by alternating two constant codes passed to indirect routines.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:68DA
name: render_slot_text_line
description: Picks a value from a table selected by a mode global, with fixed overrides for two modes and a floor of four, and passes it with a parameter to indirect routines. It chooses one of two constant codes by the parity of the parameter before drawing the line.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:6A76
name: setup_mode_tables
description: Switches on a mode word; for mode zero with parameter five it builds a five-entry pointer table and calls indirect routines with fixed sizes, while other cases are handled by further calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:7EAC
name: poll_coordinate_then_dispatch
description: Polls an indirect routine up to twenty-five times at the global coordinates until it returns five. If that never happens it calls an indirect routine with the coordinates, then the shared mode dispatch routine with mode five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:7EF2
name: signal_coordinate_then_dispatch
description: Calls an indirect routine with the first argument one and the global coordinates, then calls the shared mode dispatch routine with mode five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:7F1A
name: set_mode_and_dispatch
description: When bit zero of a global flag byte is clear, stores the given mode word, clears a companion byte and calls the shared mode dispatch routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:7F3A
name: load_text_metric_tables
description: Fills two seven-entry byte tables from an indirect byte reader at offsets nine apart, reads a six-byte run and notes whether it contains a newline. That result selects one of two values, ten or eight, which is stored with another indirect byte.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:7FE8
name: loop_until_counter_reaches_ten
description: Repeatedly calls an indirect routine while a global counter is below ten. The counter is not changed here, so the called routine must advance it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:7FFC
name: update_cached_slot_parameters
description: For the current record index below ten, compares three stored fields with cached globals. When a field differs, it calls an indirect routine with the new value and a constant, then updates the cache.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:827A
name: call_indexed_routine_if_flagged
description: When a bit in a global flag byte is set, calls an indirect routine with a pointer and a halved size taken from tables indexed by the parameters; otherwise it does nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:82BA
name: init_buffers_and_select_entry
description: Runs three indirect calls on consecutive global buffers with the same constant, copies a table entry selected by a global index into a global pointer, then runs one more call on another buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:830E
name: store_record_field_value
description: Stores the value passed to it into a fixed field of the record addressed by the caller, with no other effect.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8314
name: process_event_record_type
description: Handles one event record by its type byte. Type one appends a mapped code to a circular queue, while type two compares flag bits and, when they differ, handles the point in the region test.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:836A
name: queue_region_code_for_point
description: Maps a point inside a fixed screen region to a code, using a vertical offset divided by nine, and appends it to a circular byte queue when the stored flag changes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8396
name: queue_region_code_and_advance
description: Maps a point in a screen region to a code, appends it to a 128-entry circular queue, and steps the stored coordinates by offsets from a second structure until the region test ends.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:84C4
name: dequeue_queued_code
description: Returns the next byte from a 128-entry circular queue when it is not empty, advancing the read index modulo 128, and returns zero otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:84EE
name: advance_pseudo_random_state
description: Advances a 32-bit state held in a global by multiplying its low sixteen bits by a constant and adding one. It returns a value derived from the new state by shifting and masking.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8506
name: mask_next_random_value
description: Draws the next pseudo-random value and returns it ANDed with the caller's mask.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:850E
name: fetch_random_bit
description: Draws the next pseudo-random value and returns its lowest bit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8518
name: fetch_random_two_bits
description: Draws the next pseudo-random value and returns its two lowest bits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8522
name: mask_random_three_bits
description: Draws the next pseudo-random value and returns its lowest three bits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:852C
name: mask_random_six_bits
description: Draws the next pseudo-random value and returns its lowest six bits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8536
name: fetch_random_byte
description: Draws the next pseudo-random value and returns its low byte.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8540
name: fetch_random_modulo_limit
description: Draws the next pseudo-random value and returns its remainder modulo the low sixteen bits of the parameter, paired with the parameter. The caller must pass a non-zero limit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8554
name: run_format_then_library_call
description: Runs an indirect routine, then makes an indirect library call through a global library base, and returns the data register values left by the calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8580
name: format_number_right_aligned
description: Writes the decimal digits of a 16-bit value into a fixed buffer from the right, then fills the remaining positions on the left with spaces.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8588
name: format_number_into_buffer
description: Writes the decimal digits of a value into a buffer at a given index, working leftwards, and fills the remaining positions with spaces once the value reaches zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:85A4
name: fill_buffer_with_spaces
description: Writes space characters into a buffer from the given index down to zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:85D0
name: run_nested_library_loop
description: Runs three nested loops of sixteen, fifteen and five passes, calling indirect library routines on each pass and making extra calls when the outer counter exceeds nine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:86D4
name: process_string_segments
description: Walks a zero-terminated string, invoking a callback when it meets a byte with the high bit set. Otherwise it measures the next run of plain characters and passes that run to an indirect routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8728
name: lookup_map_cell_with_mask
description: Builds a bit mask from flag bits in two words, converts the coordinates to map cells clamped to a range using global offsets, and returns the byte from a table at the computed index.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8730
name: lookup_map_cell_from_registers
description: Performs the same map cell lookup as its sibling, but takes its coordinates and flags from the data registers and returns the byte from the table.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:87C8
name: call_then_decrement_counter
description: Calls an indirect routine through a global pointer, then subtracts four from a 32-bit global counter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:87EA
name: call_then_adjust_counter
description: Calls an indirect routine through a global pointer, then subtracts a global value plus four from a 32-bit global counter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8812
name: run_repeated_routine_sequence
description: Calls one routine with a value from a global, then makes many further calls to another routine with no arguments, and returns the data registers.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:88CA
name: call_routine_six_times
description: Calls one routine six times in succession with no arguments.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:88E4
name: copy_words_to_five_buffers
description: Copies 16-bit words from a source block into five destination buffers, writing two words per row at offsets that differ by forty, over a loop of sixteen rows.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:893E
name: return_from_gap_stub
description: Does nothing but return. It was decoded from a gap in the executable rather than from real routine code.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8948
name: call_routine_with_global_arg
description: Calls one routine with a value loaded from a global, then returns the data registers unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:89A2
name: call_routine_repeatedly_after_global
description: Calls one routine once with a value loaded from a global, then calls it repeatedly with no arguments.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8A3C
name: call_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine and returns without doing any other work.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8A4A
name: compute_clamped_tile_indices
description: Derives two tile coordinates from its parameters offset by global values, wraps them into a range of 128, clamps them to 46 and 23, stores the combined indices in a global, then calls a routine in a nested loop.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8B04
name: decode_bitplane_tile_words
description: Reads five table offsets from a global structure, then for each source byte extracts bits and packs them into five separate word tables, one bit per table per row.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8B9C
name: copy_tile_block_words
description: Copies eight rows of four words from a source tile table into a destination table, with destination offsets computed from the parameters and a global base.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8BEC
name: compute_tile_index
description: Adjusts two coordinates by global offsets with wrap-around, looks up a table byte at the adjusted position, and combines it with the coordinates' low bits and a global base offset.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8C58
name: fill_tile_index_buffer
description: Loops over a range of coordinates, computing a clamped index for each from global offsets, and writes table values into a buffer of words.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8D1C
name: decompress_run_length_bytes
description: Decodes a run-length stream into a destination buffer: a negative count repeats the following byte, while a positive count copies that many literal bytes. It updates a global source pointer and a counter as it goes.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8D98
name: add_table_scaled_offset
description: When the second parameter is below eight, adds half of the third parameter times a table entry to the first parameter, masking the result to fifteen bits. Otherwise it returns the first parameter unchanged.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8DC2
name: add_scaled_offset_keep_sign
description: Adds a table-scaled offset like its sibling, but keeps the sign bit of the first parameter and masks the sum to fifteen bits.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8DF4
name: copy_bit_fourteen_to_fifteen
description: Sets bit fifteen of the parameter when bit fourteen is set and clears it otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8E04
name: clear_bit_fifteen
description: Returns the data register word with bit fifteen cleared.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8E0A
name: step_position_toward_target
description: Moves the stored x and y position globals one step toward a target derived from the parameters. When a coordinate is far from its target it snaps to a fixed offset instead.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8E42
name: step_position_from_registers
description: Performs the same position step as its sibling, reading the target from data registers and snapping the stored x or y coordinate when it is far away.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8E52
name: nudge_x_and_step_y
description: Nudges the stored x position by one toward its target in either direction when the x delta exceeds twenty, then steps or snaps the stored y position.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8E5E
name: increment_x_then_step_y
description: Increments the stored x position when the x delta exceeds twenty, then steps or snaps the stored y position toward its target.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8E78
name: step_y_toward_target
description: Steps the stored y position by one toward its target when the delta is large, or snaps it to a fixed offset when the delta is very large.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8E88
name: nudge_y_when_delta_large
description: Moves the stored y position by one when the delta from its target exceeds ten.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8E94
name: advance_y_if_above_ten
description: Increments the stored y position when the input word exceeds ten.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8EAA
name: report_error_unless_two
description: When the parameter is not two, makes three routine calls with constant and global arguments, one of which uses the text 'ERROR'. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8EE2
name: classify_param_by_range
description: Returns a table byte for the parameter, but for values above ten it substitutes a class from three to ten chosen by range thresholds.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8F2E
name: read_joystick_direction
description: Decodes joystick movement from the port's data bits into a direction code taken from a table, and holds a counter that clamps at nine while the stick is centred. When a mode flag is set it selects the code from position thresholds instead.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8F42
name: read_joystick_and_dispatch
description: Performs the same joystick decoding as its sibling, then passes the result to two routine calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8F94
name: decode_joystick_and_notify
description: Decodes the joystick port's movement bits into a direction code as its siblings do. When the code differs from the stored value it stores the new code and calls a routine with it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8FE6
name: clamp_hold_counter_and_notify
description: Subtracts twenty from a hold counter and resets it when the value falls outside zero to nine. It calls a routine with the resulting code when that code differs from the stored one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:8FFA
name: reset_and_notify_idle_code
description: Clears the hold counter and, when the stored code is not nine, stores nine and calls a routine with it.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9018
name: check_routine_result_twice
description: Calls an indirect routine and returns its result, unless that result is below ten and not one. In that case it calls the routine again and returns zero when the second result is below eight and not one, otherwise the second result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9054
name: combine_five_planes_inverted
description: For each row, writes the inverted AND of five source word planes into a destination plane, looping over the rows and columns given by the parameters.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:90E6
name: setup_blitter_copy_passes
description: Calls library routines, then writes blitter registers for four passes in a loop. Each pass sets the control words, the first and last word masks, and source and destination addresses taken from a table indexed by the parameter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9176
name: set_blitter_regs
description: Writes a control value and two parameters into blitter registers, clears several control and modulo registers, and returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:91A0
name: configure_blitter_masked_passes
description: Loops over four entries, writing blitter control values, first and last word masks derived from a global, and pointers from a table. It calls a library routine first and waits for the blitter when its busy flag is set.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:925A
name: configure_single_blitter_pass
description: Sets the blitter's pointers, control word and masks from global values for one pass. It waits for the blitter first when its busy flag is set.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:92E4
name: setup_blitter_row_passes
description: Writes four blitter passes in a loop, each with a fixed control value and full masks, computing pointer offsets from a parameter and a table.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9364
name: setup_blitter_swapped_passes
description: Like its sibling, writes four blitter passes with the same control value, but with the source and destination pointer computations swapped.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:93E8
name: call_indirect_routine_once
description: Calls one indirect routine through a global vector and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:94C6
name: call_indirect_vector_once
description: Calls one indirect routine through a different global vector and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9BC0
name: compute_relative_direction_flags
description: Computes signed offsets between a stored position entry and the given coordinates, unless the kind is six, and derives sign and axis flags from them. It returns these flags combined with the offsets.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9BCA
name: compute_direction_and_lookup
description: Computes the same signed offsets and direction flags as its sibling, then looks up a value in a table with them and returns the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9C06
name: select_direction_from_offsets
description: Computes direction flags from offsets in registers and looks up a direction code in a table. It stores thirteen in a record field when the code is nine, otherwise it calls a routine with the result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9C14
name: store_direction_code_in_record
description: Computes direction flags from offsets, looks up a direction code, and stores it with a sign adjustment from a routine result into a record field. It sets another record field to thirteen when the code is nine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9C7E
name: set_record_direction_byte
description: Adds a signed direction offset to a stored byte and writes the masked result into a record field, setting another field to twelve unless the kind is five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9C8C
name: store_masked_direction_difference
description: Stores the difference of two byte values, masked to three bits, into a record field. It sets another record field to twelve unless the kind is five.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9CA8
name: step_actor_coordinate_by_param
description: For an entry in a table of up to four actors, checks its state byte. It either calls a routine with a fixed code, or steps the stored coordinate by the parameter and checks the resulting value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9D0E
name: step_actor_and_dispatch_kind
description: Subtracts a record speed value from an entry's coordinate, clearing it when it becomes negative. It then calls a routine with a code and an offset chosen by the kind parameter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9D44
name: step_actor_and_spawn
description: Subtracts a record speed value from an entry's coordinate, clearing it when it becomes negative. It then calls a routine with a kind-specific code and an offset, and runs a state check.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9D98
name: dispatch_actor_kind_and_check
description: Calls a routine with a kind-specific code and offset, then checks an entry's state byte. When the conditions match it calls a further routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9DBC
name: dispatch_actor_kind_default
description: Calls a routine with a code and offset chosen by the kind value, then checks an entry's state byte and calls a further routine when conditions match.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9DDA
name: dispatch_actor_fixed_kind
description: Calls a routine with a fixed code and offset, then performs the same state check and conditional call as its siblings.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9E4E
name: count_actor_kinds_and_report
description: Counts table entries of kind two that match two subtypes, starting from index three, then makes conditional routine calls with a global and the counts.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9E5E
name: count_actor_kinds_in_registers
description: Counts the same kind-two entries as its sibling, using register counters, then makes the same conditional routine calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9E74
name: count_actors_inner_loop
description: Counts matching entries in a loop, then makes the conditional routine calls that its siblings make at the end.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9E8C
name: count_actor_kinds_nested_loop
description: Counts entries of one kind with an inner loop over the remaining entries, then makes the conditional routine calls at the end.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9EB8
name: report_battle_counts
description: Makes the conditional routine calls for the counted entries, then calls a routine when a flag byte is set. Its text reference 'Bravely done!' shows it prints a message.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9ED0
name: report_battle_outcome_text
description: Makes the counted foe-related routine calls, then calls a routine when a flag byte is set. Its text references, 'foes fled in retreat.' and 'foes were defeated in battle.', show that it reports the battle outcome.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9F76
name: scan_entries_for_proximity
description: Tests the given entry with a routine call, then scans the other active entries and returns a nonzero code when one lies within a proximity check, or zero if none does.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9FE4
name: find_nearby_entry_code
description: Scans the active entries other than the given one for one whose stored offsets lie within eleven horizontally and nine vertically. It returns sixteen when found and zero otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:9FEA
name: find_nearby_entry_from_index
description: Scans entries starting from a register index for one within eleven horizontally and nine vertically of the reference. It returns sixteen when found and zero otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A08E
name: find_adjacent_entry_code
description: Scans the active entries other than the reference, returning sixteen for the first one within ten horizontally and eight vertically, and zero when none match.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A0A2
name: find_nearest_entry_index
description: Loops over entries from index one, skipping those of certain types, and records in a global the index with the smallest distance value. It returns that smallest value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A0B2
name: find_minimum_distance_entry
description: Loops over entries, skipping those of certain types, and updates a record field with the smallest distance value found. It returns that value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A116
name: measure_entry_distance
description: Measures the absolute horizontal and vertical distances between two entries. When the two are within a factor of two of each other it calls a routine and returns the vertical distance; otherwise it returns the horizontal distance.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A194
name: call_pair_if_ratio_met
description: When the first value is at most twice the second, calls two routines through a global vector. Otherwise it does nothing.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A1A0
name: call_two_indirect_routines
description: Calls two routines through a global vector in succession and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A1B2
name: try_move_entry_to_point
description: Transforms an entry's stored coordinates with two indirect calls. It stores the new coordinates when a routine check returns zero, and returns true in that case.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A240
name: store_entry_coordinates
description: Stores the two data register values as the coordinates of an entry chosen by an index in the caller's record, and returns one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A264
name: draw_frame_from_table
description: Loads four bytes from a table indexed by the parameter, then calls an indirect routine with fixed dimensions and an offset. When the parameter is below nine it repeats the call using the loaded values.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A33C
name: fill_weighted_tile_table
description: Chooses a global value from the current map identifier and a flag, clamps the second parameter to a range, then runs thirty-two iterations that fill a table from indirect routine results.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A542
name: randomize_word_table_rows
description: Repeats thirty-two times: fills a table of thirty-one words with random values up to 4095 and passes it to an indirect routine along with a fixed argument.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A59E
name: process_queued_command
description: Dequeues the next code from a 32-entry circular queue when one is pending, and dispatches it through a switch of routine calls. When the queue is empty it calls a routine with a constant instead.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A5BC
name: dispatch_next_queued_command
description: Dequeues the next code from the same 32-entry circular queue and runs the same switch of routine calls, without checking for an empty queue.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A7C4
name: dispatch_command_code
description: Dispatches on a code in a data register, calling routines with values from display-related globals for each matching case.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A844
name: enqueue_command_byte
description: Appends a byte to a 32-entry circular queue when the queue is not full, moving the write index on with wrap-around.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A872
name: print_string_with_default_layout
description: Measures a zero-terminated string, makes two layout calls with fixed positions and sizes, then calls a routine with the string and its length.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A88A
name: setup_default_layout
description: Makes two layout calls with fixed positions and sizes, then calls a routine to finish the layout.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A8CC
name: print_counted_string
description: Measures a zero-terminated string and calls a routine with the string and its length.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A8E4
name: stub_self_recursive_call
description: Its only instruction is a call that resolves back to itself, so it has no effect of its own.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A8F6
name: wrap_text_into_line_buffer
description: Copies a zero-terminated text into a 37-character buffer word by word, expanding percent signs from a pointer table and stopping at the end of text or a carriage return.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A916
name: copy_text_line_with_expansion
description: Copies characters from the text pointer into a line buffer, recording word breaks at spaces and ending the line on zero or a carriage return. It calls a routine for each completed line.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A950
name: append_expanded_text_char
description: Appends one text character to the output buffer. For a percent sign it appends the text of the current pointer-table entry instead, then continues reading the input.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A982
name: continue_text_scan_loop
description: Increments the scan count and reads the next character, ending the scan on a carriage return or once the count reaches its limit.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A984
name: store_char_and_continue_scan
description: Stores the current character in the output buffer, then continues the text scan loop as its siblings do.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A9CA
name: finish_text_line_and_scan
description: Terminates the current line buffer with zero and, while the count is within its limit, calls a routine and continues scanning the input text.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A9F4
name: return_without_effect
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:A9FC
name: wrap_text_from_table_entry
description: Skips a number of zero-terminated strings from a text base, then wraps the following text into the line buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AA06
name: wrap_text_from_second_table
description: Skips a number of zero-terminated strings in a second text block, then wraps the following text into the line buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AA10
name: wrap_text_after_skipped_strings
description: Skips a count of zero-terminated strings from a given pointer, then wraps the following text into the line buffer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AA2A
name: print_search_result_text
description: Makes four routine calls with arguments from a text table indexed by a global and the parameter, two of them with a global address. Its text references, ' containing ' and ' found ', show that it prints a search result message.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AA7E
name: print_three_text_parts
description: Makes three routine calls with arguments from a text table, a global and the parameter. Its text reference ' found ' places it in the same message family as its siblings.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AABA
name: print_selected_text_entry
description: Calls one routine with the text table entry selected by a global index.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AADA
name: setup_display_and_clear_fields
description: Points a global at a display structure, calls three indirect routines on it, sets a state word and calls further routines. It then copies a block of thirty-two bytes into the structure and sets a mode byte to two.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AB44
name: initialize_tile_entry_flag
description: Calls a routine, points a global at a structure, and writes a state word with its top two bits set. It then calls another routine and sets a mode byte to three.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AB66
name: fill_tiles_descending
description: Repeatedly calls a routine with a counter that starts at one hundred and falls in steps of five, using a fixed address, until the counter is negative.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AB98
name: fill_tiles_ascending
description: Repeatedly calls a routine with a counter that starts at zero and rises in steps of five until it passes one hundred, calling an indirect routine with one after each pass.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:ABCE
name: clear_two_fields_then_call
description: Clears two 16-bit fields in a structure reached through a global pointer, then calls a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:ABEE
name: prepare_structure_pointers
description: Copies a pointer between globals, runs a fixed sequence of routine calls with small index arguments, then calls routines for the table entries and two further routines.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AC88
name: populate_entry_from_table
description: Reads several values from indirect calls, stores a shifted short and pointer copies into global arrays, and loads three bytes from a table indexed by the parameter into three 16-bit globals.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:ADF8
name: copy_entry_into_slot
description: Points a global at a slot in an array of fifty-six-byte entries chosen by the parameter. It copies a fifty-six-byte template into the slot and writes shifted position values and state two into its fields.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AE7A
name: copy_entry_to_scratch
description: Copies a fifty-six-byte block from a global source into a scratch area, clears a global long and writes a constant word, then calls a routine with the scratch address.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AEA6
name: forward_to_routine
description: Calls one routine and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AEB2
name: run_entry_setup_with_fields
description: Calls an indirect routine with a fixed address, clears a 16-bit global, then calls a routine with two pointers and three shorts loaded from arrays indexed by the parameter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AF2C
name: update_display_unless_state_two
description: Calls a routine unless the structure's state field is two and an indirect check returns zero, in which case it returns early.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AF52
name: load_songs_index
description: Opens the file named 'songs' through an indirect call, reads up to twenty-eight length-prefixed records into a table of offsets, and closes the file.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:AFFE
name: setup_viewport_when_enabled
description: When a global flag byte is clear, makes a timed call, sets up a viewport with fixed dimensions, makes two indirect calls with the parameters, and runs two more routines when a check returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:B08C
name: draw_table_entries_as_strips
description: Loops over twenty-two entries of two byte tables. For the first eleven it draws a rectangle, then calls another routine repeatedly and draws strips computed from the second table value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:B350
name: check_space_key_flag
description: Calls an indirect input routine, sets a global flag when its result equals the space character, and returns that result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:B372
name: copy_bytes_to_new_block
description: When the first parameter exceeds a fixed threshold, allocates a block of the given size through an indirect call and copies the bytes into it. It returns the new block, or the original pointer otherwise.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:B3B8
name: compute_screen_rectangle_offsets
description: Computes several screen-coordinate offsets from global positions and a parameter block, then calls library routines for the drawing steps.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:B6FA
name: init_mode_counter_and_calls
description: Sets a counter to two, makes two routine calls with arguments from tables indexed by the current mode, and copies the counter into another global when it exceeds three.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:B75C
name: store_entry_position_and_flag
description: Copies the x coordinate of a table entry into a global, stores its y coordinate plus ten in another global, and stores the parameter byte with a flag byte of one.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:B79E
name: set_entry_flag_byte
description: Looks up an entry by a computed index, either from a table or from the global entry base. It sets the entry's marker to a fixed value, or stores the parameter byte in its slot.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:B7E6
name: store_byte_in_entry_slot
description: Looks up an entry through a table indexed by a global, then writes the data byte into its slot. When that slot already holds a marker value, it sets the marker to another fixed value instead.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:B814
name: store_data_byte_at_offset
description: Stores the low byte of a data register at a fixed offset from the address register.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:B820
name: place_entries_at_random_spots
description: Resets two state bytes and a position global. When a counter and a threshold permit, it tries random positions through indirect calls up to ten times to place new entries.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:B870
name: pick_random_free_spot
description: Repeatedly draws random x and y values, with bits chosen by a global index, until an indirect test passes. It records the point in an array and increments a counter.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:B97A
name: collect_nearby_typed_entries
description: Checks entries against the current position using a bounding box around it, and collects those of types three or four that lie inside the box into a list.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BA7A
name: advance_entry_scan
description: Advances the entry scan pointer and count. While a remaining count is positive it checks the next entry's position against the same bounding box as its sibling.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BA7E
name: match_entries_into_table
description: Scans entries inside a bounding box, skips types zero and two, and for types three or four stores a new entry record while comparing positions with existing ones.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BB2A
name: initialize_new_entry_record
description: Fills a new entry record with a kind byte, a table-derived value and flags. Its code is fifteen when the source kind is four and thirteen otherwise, and it adjusts a position by a fixed step.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BB9A
name: finish_new_entry_record
description: Sets the entry's code to thirteen where needed, stores the position and offset values into the record, raises the maximum count when needed, and advances the scan pointer.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BBD4
name: record_entry_state_from_kind
description: Sets a new record's state fields from the source kind, copies a state byte to a global flag when it equals the letter f, and sets kind-dependent codes before advancing the scan.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BC46
name: copy_entry_position_and_advance
description: Sets a record byte from the source kind, copies the source's two position words and two offset words into the record, then advances the scan pointer and count.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BC5C
name: record_entry_with_state_one
description: Sets a record byte to one, copies two position words and two offset words from the source into the record, then advances the scan pointer and count.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BC9E
name: return_from_scan_stub
description: Does nothing and returns.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BCD2
name: read_line_with_history
description: Reads a line of keyboard input through indirect calls, echoing characters and handling the backspace and return keys. Completed lines are stored in a three-slot history table.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BD74
name: process_input_line_key
description: Handles one key of a line-input loop. Printable characters are appended to a nine-character buffer, and on return the buffer is compared with the stored history, returning zero on a mismatch.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BD84
name: process_input_key_loop
description: Appends a printable character to the input buffer, then loops reading keys until return or backspace. The completed line is compared with the history entries.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BDB4
name: check_history_match
description: Compares the input buffer with a stored history entry and returns zero on mismatch. After a full match it clears the slot and counts matches, returning one at three, otherwise it selects the next stored entry.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BDD6
name: compare_text_with_history_entry
description: Compares a text pointer with the input buffer character by character, returning zero on mismatch. After a full match it clears the matched slot and selects the next entry, like its siblings.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BDD8
name: clear_matched_history_slot
description: Clears the matched history slot and counts matches, returning one after three. Otherwise it selects the next stored entry and makes its calls.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BDF8
name: call_library_cleanup_sequence
description: Makes library calls through two global library bases in a fixed sequence, repeating two of the calls on the same base.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BE5C
name: store_and_dispatch_result
description: Calls a routine with two parameters, stores the returned value in a global, calls another routine with it when it is nonzero, and returns the stored value.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BE8A
name: store_result_and_dispatch_table
description: Calls a routine with a global pointer and a fixed argument, stores the result, and when it is nonzero calls routines depending on a table lookup. It returns the stored result.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BEE6
name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Bad instruction data decoded from a gap in the executable, with no real behaviour.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BEEA
name: wait_for_flag_then_clear
description: Waits up to 300 iterations of a routine call with argument five for a global flag byte to become nonzero. When it is set, the flag is cleared and the routine returns one; otherwise it returns zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BEF4
name: poll_flag_then_clear
description: Repeats a routine call with argument five up to 300 times, checking a global flag. On success it clears the flag and returns one, otherwise zero.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BF04
name: poll_flag_without_clear_first
description: Polls a global flag with a delayed routine call up to 300 times and clears the flag when it is set, returning one. It returns zero if the flag is never set.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BF1E
name: open_disk_file_by_letter
description: Builds a file name ending with a letter derived from the parameter, chooses one of two identifiers by a flag, and makes an indirect call with them. A failed open leads to retry routines.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BF4E
name: open_winpic_disk_file
description: Repeats a loop that checks for a disk and opens the picture file whose name is built from a drive text and a slot letter, retrying until the open succeeds. Its text reference 'df0:winpic' names the file.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BF7A
name: prompt_for_writable_disk
description: Loops over disk checks and, when the disk is not ready, prints a message asking for a writable disk. Its text references 'Aborted.' and 'Insert a writable disk in ANY drive.' show that it reports the failed operation.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BF9A
name: transfer_state_blocks_on_open
description: Repeats the disk-open attempt. Once a file opens, it passes several global blocks and their fixed sizes to a routine.

key: faery tale adventure, the (1986)(microillusions)[a2]/Faery Tale Adventure, The (1986)(MicroIllusions)[a2].adf:fmain:0:BF9C
name: transfer_state_blocks_after_open
description: Opens the slot file named from the letter. When the open succeeds, it passes several global blocks with fixed sizes to a routine; otherwise it runs a retry routine.
